name: AE Snap Report
description: Daily high-level dashboard of Annual Enrollment progress: employer selection status, election-type breakdown, daily timeline, YoY comparison, and Synod/Region breakdown.

feeds.description: Status / Synod-Region / Election Sub-Type / Date / Year. Timeline rows (Date populated) now carry Year too (2026 or 2027, added 2026-09-14) -- the Timeline renders as a YoY grouped bar chart, two bars per calendar day, one per plan year. Election Sub-Type also carries the 5 Election_Status values (Open/Completed EL/Completed OTP/Default/Default Override, added 2026-09-17) for the 'By Election Status' panel -- matched by value against this closed vocabulary, same as the HSA and Eligible Count row-kinds.

Deprecated 2026-09-10 — no longer read by the widget. Timeline data now rides inside employerStatus's Date dimension instead (SAC's Builder UI can only bind one model per widget). Kept declared for manifest compatibility only.

Deprecated 2026-09-11 — no longer read by the widget. This binding's original design (Benefit Type / Changed Flag) is dead; the real YoY panel (health-plan bucket comparison, HSA collapse, eligible-count delta) now rides inside employerStatus's Election Sub-Type/Year dimensions instead (same one-model-per-widget limitation as dailyCounts). Kept declared for manifest compatibility only.

refresh.description: Re-renders the dashboard from the currently bound data
